cfg.AdvertiseServer.hint: Registers the server on the master server so anyone can find it in the game's server list. Needs account verification turned on.
cfg.AllowFallingBlocks.hint: Since 1.21 falling blocks are a world setting (allowFallingBlocks). This field is only read when a save from an older version is opened.
cfg.AllowFireSpread.hint: Since 1.21 fire spread is a world setting (allowFireSpread). This field is only read when a save from an older version is opened.
cfg.AllowPvP.hint: Players can hurt each other. The player's role also needs the attackplayers privilege.
cfg.AnalyzeMode.hint: Checks every loaded chunk for corruption and logs what it finds. Slower; meant for diagnosing a broken save.
cfg.AntiAbuse.hint: Basic level checks reach distance and bans for mass block breaking. The developers call it buggy — use with care.
cfg.AntiAbuseBlockBurstAbuseBanDays.hint: How long a player is banned for exceeding the block-break limit.
cfg.AntiAbuseBufferSize.hint: How many recent block breaks per player the server remembers for that check. Must be no less than the block limit.
cfg.AntiAbuseTriggerOnBlockBreakCount.hi: A player who breaks this many blocks within the time window gets banned. Works when anti-cheat protection is on.
cfg.AntiAbuseTriggerOnDurationMs.hint: Time window for the block-break limit.
cfg.BlockTickChunkRange.hint: Random block updates (crop growth and the like) run within this many chunks around each player.
cfg.BlockTickInterval.hint: Pause between passes of the random block update system.
cfg.ChatRateLimitMs.hint: Minimum pause between chat messages from one player.
cfg.ClientConnectionTimeout.hint: Drop a client that hasn't responded for this many seconds.
cfg.CompressPackets.hint: Compresses large network packets: less traffic for a little CPU time.
cfg.ConfigVersion.hint: Format version of this file. The server uses it to upgrade old configs and sets it itself.
cfg.CorruptionProtection.hint: Passed to the save database when the world is opened; meant to protect the world file from corruption. Keep it on.
cfg.DefaultSpawn.hint: Obsolete: the spawn point now lives in the save. Set it in game with /serverconfig setspawn.
cfg.DieAboveErrorCount.hint: The server shuts down once it has logged more errors than this.
cfg.DieAboveMemoryUsageMb.hint: The server shuts down when it uses more RAM than this. A warning is logged at 90%.
cfg.DieBelowDiskSpaceMb: Stop when free disk space below, MB
cfg.DieBelowDiskSpaceMb.hint: The server shuts down when free disk space drops below this, to protect the save. Due to a game bug, 2048 and above turn the protection off.
cfg.DisableAutoRemap.hint: After a game update, don't fix renamed blocks and items automatically — an admin has to apply the remaps by hand.
cfg.DisableModSafetyCheck.hint: Don't check mods at startup against the mod database's list of blocked mods.
cfg.EntityDebugMode.hint: Sends extra debug data about creatures to clients. For mod developers; costs performance.
cfg.GroupChatHistorySize.hint: Version 1.22.7 doesn't seem to use this setting.
cfg.HostedMode.hint: For hosting providers: some commands (backups, tick rate, player limit) work only from the server console.
cfg.HostedModeAllowMods.hint: In hosted mode, still allow installing mods with the /moddb command.
cfg.Ip.hint: Local address the server accepts connections on. Leave empty to accept them on all addresses — that's what you usually want.
cfg.KickClientsAfterAfkSeconds.hint: Kick a player who has been idle for this many seconds. 0 = never.
cfg.LastLaunchPlaystyle.hint: Service field the server maintains itself. In 1.22.7 it always stays empty.
cfg.LogBlockBreakPlace.hint: Writes every broken and placed block to server-build.log. Helps to find griefers.
cfg.LogFileSplitAfterLine.hint: Start a new log file once the current one has this many lines.
cfg.LoginFloodProtection.hint: Rejects connection attempts that come from one IP address faster than twice a second.
cfg.MapSizeX.hint: World size west to east, in blocks. Only for a new world; the World width world setting, if set, takes priority.
cfg.MapSizeY.hint: World height in blocks, a multiple of 32. Used only when a new world is created.
cfg.MapSizeZ.hint: World size north to south, in blocks. Only for a new world; the World length world setting, if set, takes priority.
cfg.MasterserverUrl.hint: Where the server registers for the public list. If empty, it can't be listed. Don't change without a reason.
cfg.MaxChunkRadius.hint: Upper limit for players' view distance. 1 chunk = 32 blocks; higher values load the server more.
cfg.MaxClients.hint: How many players can be online at the same time.
cfg.MaxClientsInQueue.hint: How many players may wait in a queue when the server is full. 0 turns the queue off.
cfg.MaxMainThreadBlockTicks: Max block ticks per server tick
cfg.MaxMainThreadBlockTicks.hint: Upper limit of block updates processed in one server tick.
cfg.MaxOwnedGroupChannelsPerUser.hint: How many player groups (with their chat channels) one player may own.
cfg.ModDbUrl.hint: Mod database the /moddb command downloads mods from.
cfg.ModIdBlackList.hint: Mod IDs that players' game clients must not load on this server, one per line.
cfg.ModIdWhiteList.hint: If set, players' game clients may load only these mod IDs (one per line); the blocked list is then ignored.
cfg.ModPaths.hint: Folders the server loads mods from, one per line. Relative paths count from the game folder. Keep Mods: the game's own content is there.
cfg.NextPlayerGroupUid.hint: Counter for player group IDs. The server maintains it itself.
cfg.OnlyWhitelisted.hint: Obsolete: replaced by the Whitelist setting. The server ignores this field.
cfg.PassTimeWhenEmpty: Time passes on an empty server
cfg.PassTimeWhenEmpty.hint: Keep the in-game calendar running while nobody is online.
cfg.Password.hint: Players enter it to join. Leave empty for no password. Stored in the file as plain text.
cfg.Port.hint: TCP and UDP port of the server. Open or forward it so others can connect.
cfg.RandomBlockTicksPerChunk.hint: How many random blocks in each chunk are picked for an update per pass.
cfg.RegenerateCorruptChunks.hint: If a chunk can't be read, generate it again instead of stopping. Anything built there is lost.
cfg.RepairMode.hint: Overwritten at every start with the Repair mode switch from the Safeguards and repair group — change it there.
cfg.ServerDescription.hint: Text for the public server list. Matters only if the server is listed there.
cfg.ServerIdentifier.hint: Unique ID the server generated for itself on first start.
cfg.ServerLanguage.hint: Language of server-side texts: system chat messages and command replies.
cfg.ServerName.hint: Name players see in the public server list and when connecting.
cfg.ServerUrl.hint: Link to your server's website, shown in the public server list.
cfg.SkipEveryChunkRow.hint: World generation debugging: leaves empty stripes in newly generated terrain. Keep 0.
cfg.SkipEveryChunkRowWidth.hint: Width of the empty stripes, in chunks. Works together with Skip chunk rows. Keep 0.
cfg.SpawnCapPlayerScaling.hint: How much the creature spawn limit grows with each extra player online. 0 = it doesn't grow.
cfg.StartupCommands.hint: Commands run once the world has loaded, one per line, as if typed in the server console. Start each with /; a line without it goes to chat.
cfg.TemporaryIpBlockList.hint: Temporarily blocks addresses that flood the server with logins or send broken packets.
cfg.TickTime.hint: Target length of one server tick. 33.33 ms = 30 ticks per second.
cfg.Upnp.hint: Asks your router to forward the port automatically. Works only if the router supports UPnP.
cfg.UpnpInfiniteLifetime.hint: Ask the router for a mapping that never expires instead of a 10-minute one the server keeps renewing. Try it if UPnP fails.
cfg.VerifyPlayerAuth.hint: Checks with the auth server that each player really owns their account. If off, anyone can join under any name.
cfg.VhIdentifier.hint: Sent to the master server when the server registers; its purpose isn't documented. Best left empty.
cfg.WarnClientsAfterAfkSeconds.hint: Warn an idle player after this many seconds. 0 = no warning. Works only when the AFK kick is on.
cfg.WelcomeMessage.hint: Chat message every player gets on joining. {playername} or {0} is replaced with the player's name.
cfg.WhitelistMode.hint: On: only whitelisted players can join. On a dedicated server, Default works the same as On.
cfg.WorldConfig.AllowCreativeMode.hint: Filled in by the game when a world is created. The 1.22.7 server doesn't seem to read it.
cfg.WorldConfig.CreatedByPlayerName.hint: Player name written into a new world as its creator. Optional.
cfg.WorldConfig.DisabledMods.hint: Mods the server must not load: one per line, as modid or modid@version.
cfg.WorldConfig.MapSizeY.hint: If set, replaces World height at every start. Leave empty to use World height itself.
cfg.WorldConfig.PlayStyle.hint: Set of world rules for a new world. Used only when the world is created. Creative Building needs the Superflat world type.
cfg.WorldConfig.PlayStyleLangCode.hint: Only picks the play style's name in world and server lists; doesn't change any rules. Usually preset-<style>, e.g. preset-exploration.
cfg.WorldConfig.RepairMode.hint: Starts the world in repair mode: unreadable chunks are deleted, players join as spectators. Back up the world first; turn off afterwards.
cfg.WorldConfig.SaveFileLocation.hint: Full path to the world file (.vcdbs). If there is no such file, a new world is created there.
cfg.WorldConfig.Seed.hint: World generation seed: a number or any text. Empty = random. Used only when a new world is created.
cfg.WorldConfig.WorldConfiguration.hint: Changes to the play style's rules. Applied once, when the world is created; in an existing world use /worldconfig <key> <value>.
cfg.WorldConfig.WorldName.hint: Name written into a newly created world. Doesn't rename an existing one.
cfg.WorldConfig.WorldType.hint: Terrain generator for a new world: normal landscape or flat.
cfg.noClientConfigRun: No clientsettings.json — start the game at least once
cfg.noServerConfigRun: No serverconfig.json — start the server at least once

srv.watchdogGaveUp: ⚠ The server crashed more than {0} times in an hour — the watchdog stops restarting it. Check the log.
srv.watchdogWaiting: ▸ The watchdog is waiting: {0} The server will start once the world is free.
srvcfg.askChangedOnDisk:
serverconfig.json has changed on disk since it was opened (the server may have rewritten it, or a mod was toggled on the Mods page).

Yes — overwrite it with your version.
No — reload it from disk; your changes will be lost.
Cancel — do nothing.
srvcfg.askOverwrite:
serverconfig.json has changed on disk since it was opened. Overwrite it with your version?

No — your changes will be lost.
srvcfg.askReload: Unsaved changes will be lost. Reload the file from disk?
srvcfg.askSaveBeforeStart:
The configuration has unsaved changes — the server will not see them. Save before starting?

No — start with the file as it is on disk.
srvcfg.askSaveOnClose: Save changes to serverconfig.json before closing?
srvcfg.askSaveOnSwitch: Save changes to serverconfig.json of profile “{0}”?
srvcfg.badgeLegacyTip: Outdated or no longer used by the server.
srvcfg.badgeWorldCreationTip: The server reads this only when it creates the world. For an existing world the change does nothing.
srvcfg.cantSave: Can't save right now: some fields have errors, or the server is running. Open Server → Configuration to sort it out.
srvcfg.draftFailed: The config changes were not saved, and writing a draft failed too: {0}
srvcfg.failedHint: The file is left as it is. Fix it by hand, then press “Reload”.
srvcfg.genNoFile:
The server exited, but serverconfig.json did not appear. Its last lines:
{0}
srvcfg.genTimeout: The server did not finish in {0} s.
srvcfg.missingHint: Create it with one click: the server writes a default config and exits — it does not start and no world is created. Or just start the server: it creates the file on first launch.
srvcfg.notSavedRoleErrors:
Not saved — the roles have errors:
{0}
srvcfg.runningReadOnly: The server is running — read-only. A running server keeps its settings in memory and rewrites the file itself, so edits made now would be lost. Stop the server to change settings.
srvcfg.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or JSON field
srvcfg.worldExists: The world already exists. Settings marked “only at world creation” are read once, when the world is created — changing them now does nothing. In an existing world, world settings are changed with the /worldconfig command.
srvcfg.wsDuplicate: This setting is already listed above
srvcfg.wsEmpty: No settings here — the world uses the defaults of its play style.
srvcfg.wsHint: Key–value pairs the world is created with. In an existing world they are changed with /worldconfig <key> <value>.
srvcfg.wsKeyTip: Pick a setting the game knows, or type any key (for example, one added by a mod)
srvcfg.wsNoKey: Pick a setting or remove this row
srvcfg.wsUnknown: The game doesn't know this setting — check the spelling. It may belong to a mod.
srvnotify.agentOld: The agent on that computer is older than this eViSTool: update eViSTool there to use notifications.
srvnotify.backupFailedHint: A scheduled backup or the one before a restart.
srvnotify.crashedHint: With the mod to blame, if it can be found, and whether the watchdog starts it again.
srvnotify.hint: The server agent sends the notifications itself, so the window can be closed. Channels are set up in Settings.
srvnotify.joinedHint: Can be a lot on a busy server.
srvnotify.leftHint: Not sent when the server stops.
srvnotify.lowDiskHint: Less than 5 GB free on the disk with the server data: backups and the world may stop being saved.
srvnotify.modUpdatesHint: Checked once a day, with the list of mods; the same list is not sent again.
srvnotify.modsUpdatedHint: On a scheduled restart, with the list of mods.
srvnotify.noChannels: No notification channels yet. Add one in Settings (Telegram, Discord, ntfy or a webhook), then turn it on here.
srvnotify.overloadedHint: Many "Server overloaded" warnings in a short time; at most once an hour, with a hint.
srvnotify.restartSoonHint: Once per scheduled restart, at the first warning to players.
srvnotify.startFailedHint: It stopped before it was up, often because of a mod.
srvnotify.stoppedHint: Stopped on purpose: by a button, a command or for a restart.
srvnotify.test: Send a test from the server
srvnotify.testSent: The test was sent to every channel in use. Check that it arrived.
srvnotify.testTip: Sent the same way as real notifications: by the server agent, to every channel turned on here.
srvnotify.testing: Sending a test from the server…
srvnotify.title: What to report and where
status.latestUnmarked: Latest version, but the author has not marked it for {0}

update.badArchive: The archive does not contain eViSTool.exe — this is not an eViSTool release.
update.badHash: The downloaded file does not match the checksum of the release — it was damaged or replaced on the way. Nothing was installed.
update.noHash: The release has no checksum — the download cannot be verified, so it will not be installed.
update.rateLimited: GitHub limited the number of checks from your address for now (60 per hour). Try again in a few minutes.
wcopy.asideLabel: set aside before putting a copy back
wcopy.closeGame: Close the game first: it keeps the world open and would write it over the copy on exit.
wcopy.copying: Copying the worlds you played before changing mods…
wcopy.gameRunning: The game is running — the worlds were not copied
wcopy.hint: Single-player worlds of this profile, copied before mods were changed: one copy per world, refreshed only after you played it. If a mod update broke a world, put the copy back.
wcopy.noSpace: not enough disk space: {0} MB needed, {1} MB free
wcopy.none: No copies yet — they appear the first time mods of this profile change (if “Copy single-player worlds before changing mods” is on).
wcopy.restoreAsideConfirm: Put back the world “{0}” as it was before the copy was restored?
wcopy.restoreConfirm:
Put back the world “{0}” from the copy of {1}?

wcopy.restoreFailed: Could not put back the world “{0}”: {1}

wcopy.title: World copies
ws.allowCoordinateHud.hint: Players may show the coordinates overlay.
ws.allowFallingBlocks.hint: Loose blocks such as sand and gravel fall when unsupported.
ws.allowFireSpread.hint: Fire spreads to nearby flammable blocks.
ws.allowLandClaiming.hint: Players may claim land to protect it from others.
ws.allowMap.hint: Players may use the world map.
ws.allowUndergroundFarming.hint: Crops can grow below sea level under artificial light.
ws.auctionHouse.hint: A server-wide auction is available at traders.
ws.blockGravity.hint: Which loose blocks fall when nothing supports them.
ws.blockGravity.value.sandgravelsoil: Sand, gravel and soil with sideways instability
ws.bodyTemperatureResistance.hint: Outside temperature in °C that a player without clothes can stand.
ws.caveIns.hint: Unstable rock can collapse while you mine.
ws.classExclusiveRecipes.hint: Some recipes are available only to certain character classes.
ws.clutterObtainable.hint: Whether clutter found in ruins can be collected by breaking it.
ws.clutterObtainable.value.ifrepaired: Only if first repaired using glue
ws.colorAccurateWorldmap.hint: The map uses real block colours instead of the old-parchment look.
ws.creatureHostility.hint: Whether creatures attack on sight, only when provoked, or never.
ws.creatureStrength.hint: Multiplier for the damage creatures deal.
ws.creatureSwimSpeed.hint: Multiplier for the swimming speed of all creatures.
ws.daysPerMonth.hint: Days in a month. Sets how long the year and the seasons last.
ws.deathPunishment.hint: Whether players drop or keep their inventory when they die.
ws.droppedItemsTimer: Timer for items dropped on death
ws.droppedItemsTimer.hint: How long items dropped on death stay on the ground, in real time.
ws.geologicActivity.hint: Higher activity brings hot springs and lava closer to the surface.
ws.globalDepositSpawnRate.hint: Multiplier for how often ore deposits generate.
ws.globalForestation.hint: More or fewer forests and shrubs.
ws.globalPrecipitation.hint: Makes the whole world wetter or drier.
ws.globalTemperature.hint: Makes the whole world warmer or colder.
ws.graceTimer.hint: Days after world creation during which monsters don't appear.
ws.graceTimer.value.0: No timer. Monsters spawn right away.
ws.harshWinters.hint: Cold kills crops, and winters bring fewer animals and less meat.
ws.landcover.hint: Share of the world that is land; the rest is ocean.
ws.landformScale.hint: Size of terrain features such as mountains, lakes and plains.
ws.lightningFires.hint: Lightning can start a fire where no lightning rod protects the spot.
ws.loreContent.hint: Generate story locations and other traces of past civilisations.
ws.lungCapacity.hint: How long a player can stay underwater. The value itself is in milliseconds.
ws.microblockChiseling.hint: Which blocks can be carved with a chisel.
ws.noLiquidSourceTransport: Prevent liquid source transport by buckets
ws.noLiquidSourceTransport.hint: Buckets can't be used to create new water sources.
ws.oceanscale.hint: How far apart pieces of land are: bigger values mean wider oceans between them.
ws.playerHealthPoints.hint: Base health of a player, before bonuses from nutrition.
ws.playerlives.hint: How many times a player may die before being out for good.
ws.polarEquatorDistance.hint: Distance from pole to equator, in blocks. Realistic climate only.
ws.propickNodeSearchRadius.hint: Range of the prospecting pick's node search mode. 0 turns that mode off.
ws.saplingGrowthRate.hint: Multiplier for the time a sapling needs to become a tree: lower is faster.
ws.seasons.hint: Seasons change through the year, or the world stays in one season.
ws.snowAccum.hint: Snow piles up and water freezes in the cold; both melt when it gets warm.
ws.spawnRadius.hint: Players without their own spawn point appear at a random spot within this distance of the world spawn.
ws.startingClimate.hint: Climate of the area where players first appear. Realistic climate only.
ws.storyStructuresDistScaling.hint: Scales how far apart the story locations are.
ws.surfaceCopperDeposits.hint: How often copper shows up on the surface.
ws.surfaceTinDeposits.hint: How often tin shows up on the surface.
ws.temporalGearRespawnUses.hint: How many times a spawn point set with a temporal gear works.
ws.temporalRifts.hint: Temporal rifts on the surface that monsters come out of: off, invisible or visible.
ws.temporalStability.hint: Turns the temporal stability mechanic on or off.
ws.temporalStormSleeping.hint: Whether players may sleep through temporal storms.
ws.temporalStorms.hint: How often temporal storms happen. Each storm is stronger and comes sooner than the last — up to a cap that is higher for the more frequent options.
ws.tempstormDurationMul.hint: Multiplier for how long temporal storms last.
ws.toolDurability.hint: Multiplier for how long tools last.
ws.toolMiningSpeed.hint: Multiplier for how fast tools break blocks.
ws.upheavelCommonness.hint: How common large raised, hilly regions are.
ws.worldClimate.hint: Realistic: climate changes from the poles to the equator. Patchy: warm and cold areas are scattered randomly.
ws.worldEdge.hint: Whether the world edge stops players or lets them fall off.
ws.worldLength.hint: World size north to south, in blocks. Takes priority over the World length (Z) field.
ws.worldWidth.hint: World size west to east, in blocks. Takes priority over the World width (X) field.
